D.t: Jared Huffman leads by 44.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 115,118 votes; a one point swing is about 1,304 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +36.7 and D +51.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
